items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: It’s not Howard Alden right now is it?

ctx.x: Joe has a fine group right now of musicians he usually works with, which includes a young guitarist that — let’s see his piano player is Norman Simmons, and let’s see if I can remember the guitar player.
It’s not Howard Alden right now is it?
